testcase.name: repeating the same hit, or adding weaker hits from the same source, adds no evidence
a second independent source changes source counts but not the correlated group maximum
adding 100 unrelated candidates leaves an existing candidate's vector unchanged
weak candidates are retained: every claimed function yields a candidate, no threshold
context-derived claims and integrator posteriors never become baseline sequence evidence
non-finite raw scores are ignored and noted, not propagated
missing is not absent: unavailable context is flagged, measured zero is a different vector
predictor run failures are reported as coverage, separate from evidence
a skipped predictor is missing coverage, not a completed negative scan
raw cohort counts cannot change learned features
legacy unweighted cohort summaries are provenance only
complex membership is not catalytic function; roles are distinct candidates
a GO term without an aspect is flagged unknown, never assumed BP
same-function candidates on neighbouring proteins are visible as competitors (paralog / decoy signal)
metabolic-gap information is a listing indicator; closed gaps are not listed
FBA features count only when the objective did not itself require the candidate
assembly features expose truncation risk and fragmentation
vectors always match the contract width and names
